summary.intent: Add Phase 27 (Writable Shares PoC) to the roadmap, capture implementation decisions via discuss-phase, and kick off research + planning for extending Phase 14's read-only sharing to support read-write shares.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 was added to the roadmap with a clean slug, CONTEXT.md was written with locked decisions across IPNS key delivery, write scope, share dialog UI, and conflict handling, and the researcher produced RESEARCH.md plus a VALIDATION.md artifact before the session ended mid-planning.

repo: Folder and file IPNS keys are randomly generated (CSPRNG), not HKDF-derived — this was a deliberate migration from deterministic derivation specifically to enable future write-sharing without exposing the user's secp256k1 private key.
Vault-level IPNS keys (vault, vault-key-blob, BYO-IPFS config, device registry) remain HKDF-derived because they must be discoverable from a recovery phrase before any metadata is decrypted.

CipherBox's server-relayed IPNS architecture sidesteps the general 'unsolved multi-writer IPNS' problem — all publishes go through the API which acts as coordination point, making the existing 409/expectedSequenceNumber flow sufficient for multi-writer conflict resolution.

The IPNS private key for subfolders is already ECIES-wrapped to the owner's public key in the parent's encrypted metadata; write sharing only requires additionally wrapping it to the recipient's pubkey.
Phase 14 CONTEXT.md explicitly defers read-write sharing as a future phase, citing multi-writer IPNS as the blocker — but this was overly conservative given the server-relay architecture.
Milestone 4 REQUIREMENTS.md TEAM-11 plans a separate read/write key hierarchy for cryptographic role enforcement.

workflow: The gsd-tools CLI generates absurdly long slugs from verbose phase descriptions — manual directory rename and roadmap edit were needed to produce a clean slug (27-writable-shares-poc).
The depends-on field in auto-generated roadmap entries defaults to the previous phase number rather than the logical dependency — required manual correction (26 → 14).
The discuss-phase workflow's prior context loading from Phase 14 CONTEXT.md successfully prevented re-asking already-decided questions (share dialog style, instant share model, etc.).
Checking the actual implementation before answering architecture questions (IPNS key derivation) was essential — the planning docs described the old behavior, code showed the migrated reality.
